snippet.title: Something is Inside Your House...
snippet.description:
Something is Inside Your House...

And it's something horrifying.

Verity's voice actor (did an even GREATER job than part 1): @JustWhispy 
Friend in the video: @Twixxel_lesgo 

My Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/033vHZW7F2GVDiC44bHwfj

This is part 2 of the Minecraft Verity Series:
Something I trusted has been here longer than I knew. Every exit leads back home. Every village is empty. And the friend I brought to help me disappeared without a sound, while he just kept smiling.

NO,  you CANNOT repost dubbed versions of my videos. If you dubbed them, email me and I might add it as an official audio track.

Intro - 0:00 - 0:26
Video - 0:26 - 20:42
Outro - 20:42 - 20:51

snippet.title: ICE CITY | EPISODE 2
snippet.description:
ICE CITY | Official Trailer

Set against the backdrop of modern London culture, Ice City explores friendship, pressure, street politics, family, and the choices people make when they are trying to rise above their circumstances.

What starts as ambition soon becomes a test of loyalty, as each character is forced to decide who they really are, who they can trust, and how far they are willing to go.

Raw, stylish, and character-driven, Ice City captures the energy of London youth culture through sharp dialogue, music, fashion, humour, and tension. It is not just about conflict, but about identity, brotherhood, legacy, and the cost of chasing power in a city that does not give second chances.

Subscribe to the channel and turn on notifications so you do not miss the release.

snippet.title: Gatto | Teaser Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
Ciao Gatto
Watch the new teaser for Disney & Pixar's #Gatto, arriving in theaters March 5, 2027

Mark Ruffalo (“Poor Things,” “The Avengers,” “Spotlight, “Foxcatcher”) has joined the voice cast as the scrappy black cat Nero, and Laurence Fishburne (“The Matrix” trilogy, “Boyz n the Hood,” “What's Love Got to Do with It”) will voice the ruthless mob boss cat Rocco. The teaser trailer introduces Nero and Rocco as they question another cat in a funny interrogation scene.
In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.
“Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” The new film releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

ABOUT PIXAR ANIMATION STUDIOS
Pixar Animation Studios, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company, is an Academy Award®-winning film studio with world-renowned technical, creative and production capabilities in the art of computer animation. The Northern California studio has created some of the most successful and beloved animated films of all time, including “Toy Story,” “Monsters, Inc.,” “Cars,” “The Incredibles,” “Ratatouille,” “WALL•E,” “Up,” “Brave,” “Inside Out,” “Coco,” “Soul,” “Turning Red,” “Elemental,” and “Inside Out 2.”

snippet.title: The Cranberries - Scenes From 'Linger' (The Only Color Reel)
snippet.description:
Scenes from 'Linger' / (The Only Color Reel) by The Cranberries

Directed by Melodie McDaniel in 1993, "Linger" was filmed almost entirely on 16mm black-and-white film, a deliberate aesthetic choice inspired by Jean-Luc Godard's 1965 noir film Alphaville. But one reel was shot in color. A brief moment from it appeared in the original music video, desaturated and lasting under 15 seconds. This is the full scene from that reel: every take, in color, restored from the original 16mm and presented in 4K for the first time.

Designed to give fans a deeper connection to the band's legacy, the "Scenes From" series strips away the traditional music video edit to present raw, 4K performance takes restored from the original film sources.

snippet.title: Paul Heaton - Favourite Kind Of Idiot (Official Video) ft. Rianne Downey
snippet.description:
#PaulHeaton #FavouriteKindofIdiot #Jenius

Pre-order the new album ‘JENIUS’ now: https://PaulHeaton.lnk.to/Jenius 
Listen to ‘Favourite Kind of Idiot’ now: https://PaulHeaton.lnk.to/FKOI 
Tickets to the UK Tour onsite now: https://lnk.to/PaulHeaton2026 

Follow Paul Heaton:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/paulheatonofficial /paulheatonofficial 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@paulheatonofficial / paulheatonofficial 
Twitter: https://x.com/PaulHeatonSolo?lang=en / paulheatonsolo 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/paulheatonofficial /paulheatonofficial
Website: https://www.paulheaton.co.uk/
Sign up for updates: https://PaulHeaton.lnk.to/signupsocials

Directed by Andy Hylton

Lyrics

I saw you tie your shoe laces
You looked so very pleased
They came undone immediately
You sank down on your knees

Later at the light bulb change
It took you several hours
I watched you punch the air in joy
I thought the future’s ours

North Korea on holiday
Beirut for a midweek break
We could go just anywhere
And make the most of our mistake

And if the sun don’t shine
Well the boy’s still mine
Like a right foot in left shoe
My favourite kind of idiot
Is you, you, you
You’re a little bit cute
But you ain’t no beaut
But I don’t date you for the view
My favourite kind of idiot is you

I saw you try to cross the road
In a fight that you still lose
Both cycle lane and bus lane
Still leaving you confused

Returning half hour later
You still looked pretty lost
Finally reached the other side
But forgotten why you’d crossed

New York, London, Milan, Paris
None of them we’ve been
Just a one day trip to the council tip
Fulfils our every dream

I can’t believe the things we do
When just left on our own
But madness and insanity
Furnished both our homes
You’re my dream idiot
I hope I’m your dream fool
Nevermind the law
Or security door
If you weren’t meant to break the rules

#PaulHeaton #FavouriteKindofIdiot #Jenius

snippet.title: Aarzu (with Asim Azhar) Official Music Video | Asim Azhar, Noor, Khan, Madhurxo
snippet.description:
If Aarzu found a place in your heart, Asim Azhar's rendition takes it even deeper. Wrapped in dreamy melodies and timeless emotion, this version captures the beauty of yearning for someone who never truly leaves.


Listen Now:
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/track/1GnZH0wek1fkGCQnUsK6D0?si=c8a640db631c4690 Apple Music -  https://music.apple.com/in/song/aarzu-with-asim-azhar/6772998267 
YouTube Music - https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=M5OCLifZK1w&si=F6FdB9DEXBskKoUu 

Audio Credits: 
Music by Asim Azhar, Khan, Noor
Lyrics by Asim Azhar, Khan, Noor
Vocals by Asim Azhar, Khan, Madhurxo
Written by Asim Azhar, Khan, Noor
Produced by Noor
Guitars by Melvin Arthur
Mixed & Mastered by Kumail Abbas

Video Credits: 
Director - Khizar Sheikh
Producer - Syed Jahanzaib Ali
Executive Producer - Gul-E-Rana
D.O.P & Edit - Fraz KB 
Grade - Maaz Ahmad Ansari

Lyrics:

(Khan)

Tera sharmana meri jaana kabhi
Rakhlu chupaake teri yaadein sabh
Khwaabon main mere hai tu hi basi

Tera sharmana meri jaana kabhi
Rakhlu chupaake teri yaadein sabh
Khwaabon main mere hai tu hi basi

(Madhurxo)

Peeche dekhu raahein teri yaadein jo rahi na meri
Khwaabon main basa hai tu hi tu.
Sawalon main main rakhlu chupake mujhe tu hi toh bigaade
Meri aankhon main saja hai tu hi tu

Peeche dekhu raahein teri yaadein jo rahi na meri
Khwaabon main basa hai tu hi tu.
Sawalon main main rakhlu chupake mujhe tu hi toh bigaade
Meri aankhon main saja hai tu hi tu

(Asim Azhar)

Oh kaisi dilkashi 
Tujh se dillagi
Mere humnasheen… hmmmm
Kioun chupaoun main
Ab koi darr nahi
Tu jaisay meri pari
Masoomiyut chulkay teri
Baatoun se kitni…hayee
Saada si jo adaa’ein teri
Qatil hai woh
Dil ki meri

Peechay dekhoun raahein teri
Yaadein jo rahi na meri
Khwaboun mein basa hai tu hi tu
Sawaaloun mein bhi rakh loun chupa ke
Mujhe tu hi tou bigaray
Meri ankhoun mein saja hai ti hi tu

(Unknown)

Phirse Bolo

(Asim Azhar)

Peechay dekho raahein teri
Yaad jo rahi na meri
Khwaboun mein basa hai tu hi tu
Sawaaloun mein bhi rakh loun chupa ke
Mujhe tu hi tou bigaray
Meri ankhoun mein saja hai ti hi tu

Tera sharmana, meri jaana kabhi
Rakh loun chupa ke teri yaadein sab hi
Khwaboun mein mere hai tu hi basi
Tu hi basi… tu hi basi

(Khan and Asim)

Tera sharmana, meri jaana kabhi
Rakh loun chupa ke teri yaadein sab hi
Khwaboun mein mere hai tu hi basi
Tu hi basi… tu hi basi

(Outro)

Dono jahan teri muhabbat mein haar ke
Woh ja raha hai koi Shab’e Ghum guzaar ke
Weera’an hai maikada khum-o-saagar udaas hain     
Tum kya gaye k rooth gaye din bahaar

The summer game fest happened the other day or as everyone still calls it E3. At not E3 E3, they showed off lots of new games. Many of them actually pretty interesting such as Ace Combat 8, Stellar Blade 2, GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, Resident Evil Veronica, TMNT by platinum games, Stranger than Heaven too although every time they show it I understand it less.

There was also a lot of bad looking games like Fable, Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced (assassin's creed black flag remake), God of War Laufey (god of chores) and a few others.

Wolverine's gameplay looks interesting, can't wait to hang out with my main men Mystique and Jean Grey. I'll need to see more on Gears of War E-Day always good to hear that guy from adventure time again. This Carmine guy seems cool I can't wait to see what is arc is over the course of the next trilogy.
